DISCOVERY 612, PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR RECONSIDERATION OF DISCOVERY ORDER IS DENIED. THE COURT DOES NOT FIND THAT THE ALLEGED FAILURE FULLY TO UNDERSTAND AND FAILURE TO COMMUNICATE THE ALLEGED SIGNIFICANCE OF CERTAIN DOCUMENTS IS A BASIS FOR RECONSIDERATION. THE NEW DECLARATION FROM PLAINTIFF DOES NOT CONTAIN FACTS NOT AVAILABLE AT THE TIME OF THE ORIGINAL HEARING ON THE MOTION. THAT NEW DECLARATION IS NOT GROUNDS FOR FINDING THAT NEW FACTS EXIST THAT WERE NOT AVAILABLE TO PLAINTIFF AT THE TIME OF THE ORIGINAL HEARING. THE SUPPLEMENTAL DECLARATION OF STEPHEN A. SOMMERS FILED ON MARCH 27, 2006 WAS NOT CONSIDERED AS IT IS UNTIMELY. THE COURT FINDS THAT THE MOTION WAS BROUGHT WITHOUT SUBSTANTIAL JUSTIFICATION.
